claim: L6 (LFP-primary analysis spec): volume conduction control -- zero-lag vs lagged LFP-LFP coupling fraction per area pair, raw vs Laplacian-referenced, within-probe vs across-probe. Built because L5 returned H3_simultaneous_or_ambiguous for every band and, per the spec's own text, an H3 verdict cannot alone distinguish genuine simultaneous engagement from a shared volume-conducted field.
implementation: context/figures/L6_volume_conduction_control/L6_volume_conduction_control.py. Reuses jnwb.spectral.imaginary_coherency (its own docstring identifies it as the estimator this project's fig06/fig07 volume-conduction control requires) and jnwb.spectral.laplacian_reference (already validated as this project's CSD estimator, L0 method d / all of L4) -- no new signal-processing primitive written. zero_lag_fraction = 1 - clip(icoh_abs_mean/sqrt(coh_mag_mean), 0, 1), stated explicitly as an informal scalar summary of imaginary_coherency's own documented coh_mag-vs-icoh comparison, not a formal variance decomposition.
comparison_design: Within-probe (V1-V2, MT-MST on this corpus) vs across-probe (FEF-PFC, V1-MT, always different probes) area pairs, probe assignment resolved FRESH per session via _l_lfp_common.find_probe_for_area, never assumed from the pair identity -- consistent with the probe-area-not-fixed finding already documented in L0-L5.
scope: Stim condition (RRRR) only, broadband 4-80 Hz, one representative channel per area (5-channel block used for Laplacian referencing, middle channel taken as representative) -- not full-area/channel-resolved coverage. Up to 3 sessions per pair. All stated limits, not hidden.
self_test: (a) synthetic purely zero-lag shared source: coh_mag=0.811, icoh_abs=0.025, zero_lag_fraction=0.973 -- PASS. (b) synthetic 20ms-lagged shared source: coh_mag=0.810 (comparable), icoh_abs=0.572 (much higher), zero_lag_fraction=0.364 (meaningfully lower than (a)) -- PASS, icoh discriminates lag as required. (c) independent noise: coh_mag=0.009 -- PASS, low as expected. (d) Laplacian re-referencing on a synthetic common-average-reference-only artifact (no real coupling): coh_mag raw=0.871 -> csd=0.010 -- PASS, re-referencing actually removes what it claims to remove. Determinism also PASS.

real_run.runtime: 34s (4 area pairs x 3 sessions x raw+CSD imaginary coherency, single representative channel per area)
real_run.result: No clean within-vs-across-probe separation in raw zero-lag fraction -- MT-MST (within-probe) has the LOWEST raw zero-lag fraction of all four pairs (0.306) and the smallest CSD-driven coherence collapse (-51%, vs -82% to -98% for the other three pairs), i.e. it looks comparatively LEAST reference-driven despite sharing a probe. V1-V2 (also within-probe) shows the opposite pattern: highest raw zero-lag fraction (0.816) and the largest coherence collapse under re-referencing (-98%). Across-probe FEF-PFC and V1-MT sit in between both raw zero-lag fraction and CSD-driven collapse. Post-CSD, all four pairs converge into a narrower band (zero_lag_fraction 0.43-0.51).
real_run.reported_honestly: This does NOT confirm the naive expectation that within-probe pairs are more volume-conduction-dominated than across-probe pairs -- reported as the actual, non-uniform finding per CLAUDE.md tripwire 10, not smoothed into a clean story.

implication_for_l5: Three of the four pairs (V1-V2, FEF-PFC, V1-MT) lose the large majority of their raw magnitude-squared coherence once Laplacian-referenced (-82% to -98%), consistent with (not proof of) a substantial reference/volume-conduction contribution to raw cross-area LFP coupling in this corpus -- the kind of contamination that could make a genuine cross-area onset lead-lag difference hard to detect, which is one plausible contributor to L5's all-H3 result. MT-MST is the clear exception (-51% only). This is stated as one input to reading L5, not a conclusion drawn in code -- L6 itself makes no claim about whether L5's H3 verdicts are genuine simultaneity or volume conduction.
not_yet_done: Single representative channel per area, not channel-resolved. n=3 sessions/pair, purely descriptive (no permutation test or CI on the zero_lag_fraction itself -- would need the within-session-shuffle-then-pool-as-proportion design from omission-signal S10 to be inferential, not done here). Broadband only, no per-band icoh (band-resolved is a stated, not-yet-built extension). Omission condition (RXRR) not run, stim only.
